message.content: {"brief_rationale":"The trajectory successfully completed the minimum responsibility chain with no serious errors. RC1 (safety triage) was adequately covered, and all other RC items were met with appropriate referrals to the inpatient team. However, the model never actively discovered or integrated a hidden state (HO1 not completed), failed to navigate privacy concerns with a specific practical strategy (HO2 not completed), and did not validly correct the caregiver's misunderstanding about the relationship between viral detection and antibiotics (HO3 not completed). HO4 (bounded closure) was partially completed with explicit boundary-setting and residual assignment, but full caregiver receipt/teach-back on the escalation plan was not robustly confirmed.
